verdict.rationale: Mercury explicitly offers invoicing with payment collection: 'Send manual and automatic invoices, accept flexible payment methods, and manage customer details' and a dedicated Accounts Receivable API (Customers, Invoices, Webhooks) supporting up to 500-unlimited invoices/month. This covers the core create-and-send-with-payment-collection workflow for a finance lead. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of invoice branding/customization (logo, templates) and independent/community confirmation of the invoicing feature in practice.
